build.//: DOCKERFILE, not NIXPACKS. This file said NIXPACKS until 2026-09-28 and Railway ignored it: a Dockerfile in the service's root directory wins over the builder named here, so the build silently switched the moment Dockerfile landed. Said out loud now, because a config file that disagrees with what actually runs is worse than no config file. nixpacks.toml stays in the repo as the record of why chromium/python3/nodejs_22 are needed -- it is no longer what builds this service.
